expectations.text: The agent located frmReceipt from the visible strings (find_screen.py or equivalent), stated it as the match, and did not ask the user which form it is
expectations.evidence: Identified frmReceipt from the given strings; no question asked

expectations.text: A unit file named exactly after the unit ID (e.g. SCR-<MODULE>-<Name>.md, ASCII) exists under modules/<MODULE>/units/ and the unit is registered in STATE.json with sources and aliases (frmReceipt, 'PHIẾU THU TIỀN')
expectations.evidence: Single free-form frmReceipt-requirements.md; no unit file, no STATE.json, no aliases/sources registration

expectations.text: Requirement IDs follow REQ-<MODULE>-<ShortName>-<nnn> with 3 digits and are not reused or duplicated
There are separate FN entries for total, payable and change with the exact formulas: total = sum(Qty x Price); payable = total - discount; change = tendered - payable
expectations.evidence: Formulas present as numbered steps in a Calculations section, but no separate FN entries

expectations.text: Each FN has at least 3 test vectors with an edge case, one of them consistent with: lines 2x100,000 and 1x50,000, discount 20,000, tendered 250,000 -> total 250,000, payable 230,000, change 20,000
The spec records that unparsable or empty discount/tendered text is treated as 0 (Parse returns 0)
expectations.evidence: States unparseable or empty input is treated as 0

expectations.text: Save validation order is recorded exactly: patient required, then at least one line, then stock check only for lines of type Drug
expectations.evidence: 'Validation on Save (in order, stops at first failure)': patient, lines, Drug stock

expectations.text: The Messages section lists all four messages: 'Vui lòng chọn bệnh nhân', 'Không có dịch vụ để thu', 'Không đủ tồn kho: <code>', 'Đã lưu phiếu thu' with their trigger conditions
expectations.evidence: All four messages present with conditions

expectations.text: Data access lists tb_Receipt (Max(Id)+1 read, INSERT) and tb_Line (UPDATE ReceiptId), and states that there is no transaction
expectations.evidence: tb_Receipt (Max(Id)+1, insert) and tb_Line; 'No transaction wraps insert and line attach'

expectations.text: The Coverage table lists all four handlers: btnSave_Click, btnPrint_Click, txtDiscount_EditValueChanged, txtTendered_EditValueChanged
expectations.evidence: No Coverage table; handler names btnSave_Click/btnPrint_Click/EditValueChanged do not appear

expectations.text: The spec notes btnPrint is disabled until a successful save, and that the 'Xóa dòng' menu item exists in the Designer but has no handler (quirk or open question)
expectations.evidence: Print disabled until save; Xóa dòng menu has no handler noted

expectations.text: IMPs are raised for the Max+1 receipt number (concurrency), the non-atomic save, and missing validation of negative payable/change; they live in IMPROVEMENTS.md / the IMP section, and the legacy REQs still describe the old behavior unchanged
expectations.evidence: No improvement proposals; anomalies are listed under 'Open anomalies' without IMP entries

expectations.text: scripts/check_unit.py exits 0 for the unit, STATE.json shows the unit DONE with doc_hash and a rev >= 1, and INDEX.md was regenerated by state.py index (not hand-edited)
expectations.evidence: No STATE.json, no gate, no INDEX

expectations.text: The final reply is short (units, counts of REQ/BR/FN/IMP, notable findings, next screens, coverage) and does not paste the whole spec into chat
